title: Apache Kafka connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One Kafka connector instance's settings: the brokers and topics it reads or writes, the consumer group, and the SASL/TLS material. Covers both directions of the ★ Kafka connector (design §33 §8 row 1; CN1 plan Task 6). Secrets are named, never stored here: `sasl.password`, `sasl.username_secret`, `tls.key_pem`, `schema_registry.basic_auth.password` and `schema_registry.basic_auth.username_secret` resolve through the namespace's secret store (D189) and are exactly the manifest's `secrets` list (CN1 Task 1's semantic rule).

brokers.description: Bootstrap brokers as host:port, comma separated. Required: there is no default cluster. A listener scheme on an entry (SASL_SSL://, SSL://, PLAINTEXT://, SASL_PLAINTEXT://, any case), as Confluent Cloud's bootstrap_endpoint sometimes carries, is removed (CC0 R0.12); any other scheme is refused.

topics.description: Topics this instance reads or writes. A route narrows the set further (§33 D355, `source` in a route).

group_id_prefix.description: Prefix of the consumer group; CN1 Task 6 names the group `loams-<ns>-<instance>`, so this is normally the namespace and instance name the runtime already knows.

group_id.description: Full consumer group id, when an instance overrides the runtime's `loams-<ns>-<instance>` default (CN1 Task 6).

transactional_id_prefix.description: Prefix of the exactly-once sink's transactional.id, which becomes <prefix><instance>-<split>; unset, loams-<ns>-. On Confluent Cloud set the confluent module's transactional_id_prefix output (default loams-<name>-), the prefix its PREFIXED ACL allows (CC1 Task 8, D1826).

enable_idempotence.description: The idempotent producer (CN1 Task 6: enable.idempotence=true with acks=all). Sink only; it may not be turned off, which is why the manifest declares sink.idempotent: true.

acks.description: The producer's acks setting. all is required with the idempotent producer.

max_poll_records.description: Records per poll; the native source's batch size before the Fabric acknowledges (Ruling 4).

auto_offset_reset.description: Where a group with no committed offset starts. earliest replays the topic; CN1 defaults to latest so a new instance does not ingest history.

security_protocol.description: The transport security (CN1 Task 6: SASL PLAIN/SCRAM over TLS, mTLS, MSK IAM).

sasl.description: SASL material. Present only when security_protocol starts with sasl_. Exactly one of username and username_secret is required once a target profile's defaults are merged (a profile may supply username, as azure-event-hubs does), so the schema itself refuses only both.

mechanism.description: The SASL mechanism (the manifest's auth slugs sasl-plain, sasl-scram-256, sasl-scram-512, aws-msk-iam).

username.description: The SASL username, as a value. Mutually exclusive with username_secret.

username_secret.description: The SASL username as the name of a secret, resolved through the secret store (D189) like password: a Confluent Cloud API key id, which loams-byoc-secrets writes beside its secret (confluent-<integration>/username, D1827). Mutually exclusive with username.

password.description: The SASL password. Resolved through the secret store (D189); never stored in the instance (CN1 Global Constraints).

tls.description: TLS material. Present only when security_protocol ends with _ssl or is ssl.

enabled.description: Whether TLS is on at all.

ca_pem.description: The CA bundle that verifies the broker, as PEM.

cert_pem.description: The client certificate for mTLS, as PEM (not a secret).

key_pem.description: The client private key for mTLS, as PEM. Resolved through the secret store (D189).

verify_full.description: Whether the broker certificate's hostname is verified (CN1 Task 6 uses verify-full for the analogous SQL drivers).

delivery.description: The sink's delivery (CN2 Task 9, OR-7): effectively_once is the idempotent producer; exactly_once writes each batch and its checkpoint in one Kafka transaction (transactional.id loams-<ns>-<instance>-<split>, checkpoint in checkpoint_topic). A target profile that narrows sink.transactional (Azure Event Hubs) refuses exactly_once.

checkpoint_topic.description: The compacted topic the transactional sink keeps its checkpoint in (key <ns>/<instance>/<split>).

create_checkpoint_topic.description: Create checkpoint_topic (compacted, one partition) when it is missing. The confluent-cloud profile sets false: Loams' data account has no CREATE there (D1826), so the module or the user creates the topic.

max_record_bytes.description: The largest record the sink writes (message.max.bytes); a larger event goes to the DLQ as poison.

recover_timeout_ms.description: How long the transactional sink's recovery may read checkpoint_topic.

poll_wait_ms.description: How long the source waits for a first record before it reports nothing.

rate_limit.description: The instance's rates, shared by its splits (D1822; §80 §8.1: Loams' connector byte rate bounds its share of a cluster's throughput charges). Mapped to the connector SDK's RateLimit, a token bucket the pipeline applies before each read or write. An absent rate is unlimited.

requests_per_sec.description: Reads or writes (batches) per second, at least 1.

format.description: How the source reads a record's value (CC1 Task 3, D1822; §80 §4.2). plain: CloudEvents pass-through or a wrapped record. debezium-json: a Debezium change event from the JSON converter, with or without its schema/payload wrapper. debezium-avro: the same in Confluent wire-format Avro, decoded with the writer schema from schema_registry (required). A Debezium event becomes a Loams change event (loamsop c/u/d/r/t, loamslsn from Debezium's source block); a record from Debezium's schema-change topic becomes a schema-change event; anything else goes to the DLQ as poison. Source only: a sink refuses anything but plain.

debezium.description: Options for format debezium-json and debezium-avro.

tombstones.description: What a tombstone (a key with no value, written after a delete for log compaction) becomes: a delete of that key, or nothing.

key_fields.description: The row fields that make the change's key (from after, or before for a delete). Empty: the record key, Debezium's key struct.

pipeline.description: The connector SDK's per-instance pipeline overrides (max_batch_rows, max_batch_bytes, linger_ms, max_in_flight_batches, memory_budget_bytes, checkpoint_interval_ms, retry).

schema_registry.description: Confluent registry, for the Avro wire format at the Kafka boundary (D356). Optional because the manifest declares schema.registry: optional (§33 §4).

url.description: The registry base URL, http:// or https://.

subject_prefix.description: Subject prefix for this instance's topics.

basic_auth.description: HTTP Basic credentials for the registry (Confluent Cloud's Schema Registry API key and secret). password, and username_secret when used, are secret names resolved through the secret store (D189); exactly one of username and username_secret.

username_secret.description: The username as a secret's name (confluent-<integration>/sr-username, D1827).

password.description: The password as a secret's name (confluent-<integration>/sr-password). Resolved through the secret store (D189); never stored in the instance.
